column1: # This is the FRESH copy installed into a new context compiler. It lists only
# the gates that ship, because a table row naming an absent gate is an error
# (exit 2), not a skip — a gate that vanishes must not be able to do so quietly.
# When /ctx-gate builds a gate under gates/, it does NOT need a row here: gates
# in gates/ are discovered by the gates/fixtures/<RULE-ID>/ convention. This
# table exists for the hand-written gates in scripts/, whose fixtures take
# gate-specific flags that cannot be guessed from a directory layout.
